02 / A little about me

The builder
behind the worlds.

On RobloxNeoStudioxView profile ↗

I’m Jatin, known on Roblox as NeoStudiox. For 3.5+ years, I’ve been building, experimenting and refining my skills across the platform.

My work combines hands on Reference based buildings or produce an new idea with time and game production, task coordination and structured playtests.

Proficient in building custom designs from the ground up or utilizing pre-made assets to construct complete, immersive environments. I conceptualize unique game ideas and maintain a tidy Roblox Studio workspace using organized folders and clear naming conventions to ensure a smooth workflow for fellow developers.

Build. Test. Learn. Repeat.Meet me on Roblox ↗
